shortDescription: Manage BIG-IP Next instance upgrades through CM

options.name: device_hostname
options.description: The hostname of the BIG-IP Next instance to be upgraded. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(device_ip).

options.name: device_ip
options.description: The ip address of the BIG-IP Next instance to be upgraded. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(device_hostname).

options.name: filename
options.description: The filename of the uploaded image on BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: sig_filename
options.description: The filename of the uploaded signature file on the BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the BIG-IP Next upgrade to complete. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of next instance to be upgraded.
